addresses.name: CUnit_IsSeenAsOwnBy
addresses.no_signature: Register convention: the unit in EAX, the observer's CCountryTag* on the stack (ret 4), a bool in AL.
addresses.comment: **Whether a country sees a unit as its own**, which makes the unit's intel level (CUnit +0x1F8) 9. 0x5D37D0 to the second `ret 4` at 0x5D3835, read end to end: the unit in **EAX**, the observer's CCountryTag* on the stack. True where the unit's owner id (+0x128) is the observer's id; else where the owner's faction (CCountry +0xD8, never null) answers its slot 7 true - a real faction - and the observer's CCountry +0xD8 is the same object; else where the owner's diplomatic status towards the observer (CCountry +0xE28[observer id]) has an alliance (+0x14). Its own units, its faction's and its allies'; no puppet, guarantee or war test. Eleven direct callers, CUnit_RefreshIntelLevel (0x5BAC63) and CUnit::EnterProvince (0x5BF23F) among them. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-counters.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py 0x5D37D0: cmp [edi+4] against the owner id at +0x128; call [vtbl+0x1C] on the owner's +0xD8 and a compare with the observer's +0xD8; cmp dword [status+0x14], 0 on +0xE28[observer id]. findRefs.py --callers: 11 direct calls.
